reviews.text: We’ve been taking our pup here for nail trims and self-wash. Plenty of parking, clean, quality products, and reasonably priced.  Angie is friendly, welcoming, and does a great job keeping our little guys nails trimmed up. Highly recommend!!
They do such a great job!!!
Just moved back to the area and so excited to be able to take Floki back here!! They do an amazing job, out boy looks so handsome!!

I usually groom my cat at home because she hates unfamiliar places, but her fur became too matted for me to manage safely. The staff handled her very gently and didn’t make me feel guilty about waiting too long to book professional grooming. They removed the mats without shaving huge bald sections, which honestly surprised me. She was definitely annoyed afterward, but much calmer than expected. By the next morning she already seemed more comfortable moving around the house again.
They are great!! We have been coming here for 3ish years. Excellent hair cuts for my goldendoodle.

Experienced dig grooming center.
Organized, punctual.   And of course we were very satisfied  with the job!
Took my Lulu in for the DIY Self wash and it was my 7th bath free, such an awesome loyalty perk! Thank you Groomer19!

This is a perfectly nice and clean self serve dog wash with blow dryers. You get a small discount if you bring your own shampoo. Overall, I think self serve dog washes are overpriced- $25 to wash my own dog plus tip for the staff? Seems a bit silly, but if in a pinch…

My first experience and they did not disappoint. Angie and team did such a great job with my big baby boy Linc. Patient with me as a new customer and took time to explain everything. Will be booking again. We found our new grooming home☺️

Update- we have a very active puppy ,Hali, who has seen Angie for the last few months. Angie is so patient with her. She knows which squeaky toy Hali likes by the bath. I had to have her shaved and Angie told me it would be a longer grooming session because she wanted Hali to be comfortable. While I was there, Angie was talking to another customer about her dogs’ favorite song while being groomed. Angie truly cares about each and every client and their fur baby. Groomer19 is an awesome woman owned small business in our community. I’ve been using Angie as a groomer for 12 years and have never heard her get upset at anyone. She is a very caring person who loves dogs/cats.

My Sadie has been groomed by Angie since she was a puppy. She’s 9 now. Angie is the most patient, knowledgeable groomer. She has a way of making dogs feel comfortable and relaxed. We had a bad experience at a groomer before we met Angie. Sadie was so scared in the beginning but now she runs to Angie and is so excited to see her. Angie has a special gift with dogs. Highly recommend!
Angie and staff are great they treat every dog like their own. Been going to Angie for many years she really knows how to make every dog and cat feel special

This place only has one bad review and it is by someone that mostly writes bad reviews.
That should tell you everything you need to know!

Groomer19 is a family-owned business with sweet staff that treat your pet like they are royalty. This weekend is my dog's birthday and he is about to get pampered before his big day!
Recommend for anyone that wants to give their pup the self-care treatment they deserve...

Shout-out to Elle. She always spoils my boy!

I brought my dog Peanut to Angie after hearing she’s amazing with dogs that are on the more difficult side and I can honestly say I’m blown away by the results. Peanut is a 7-lb Maltese who can be very challenging when it comes to grooming. He’s reactive with the leash, sensitive when his face is handled, and has struggled with blow dryers and brushing in the past. I’ve tried several groomers around San Diego before deciding to bring him to Angie.

From the start, Angie was incredibly professional and communicative. She kept me updated every step of the way, sharing how Peanut was doing throughout the appointment. She was honest about his initial reactivity with the leash, but thanks to her calm approach and positive reinforcement, Peanut responded beautifully and allowed her to continue with his bath. She even sent me videos of him calmly tolerating the blow dryer and brushing something I never thought I’d see!

The only small hiccup was that Peanut was a little wiggly during his ear trim, which is completely understandable and no big deal at all. Overall, this visit was a huge milestone for my dog, and I am beyond grateful for Angie’s patience, skill, and genuine care.

To add to this, I am a dog groomer myself so you’d think my own dog would let me groom him but Angie truly has a magical touch. She is a gem, and I am forever thankful for the positive experience she gave my dog. I will absolutely continue bringing Peanut to her and will always support her and her amazing business and staff. Highly, highly recommend!

I absolutely love bringing my pooch here and he loves it too. I bathe my dog and Angie always makes time for him to get his nails trimmed. I've never seen a dog or human leave unhappy. Angie and her staff are amazing!

I’ve been a loyal client for over a year and had never had a negative experience until this visit. I asked a simple, respectful question about billing, and Angie responded in a very rude, combative, and confrontational manner. The issue was not the pricing itself, but the way I was spoken to.

I also observed her speaking similarly to the customer before me when I walked in. There was no attempt to explain calmly, de-escalate the situation, or provide basic customer service.

After receiving no apology or follow-up, I feel it’s important to share this experience. The interaction left me uncomfortable enough that I chose not to leave my dogs for their appointment. As a pet owner, trust, professionalism, and calm handling matter, and this interaction made me uncomfortable leaving my pets in her care. Very disappointing experience after being a long-time client.
Angie was amazing! My dog came back beautiful! She was so sweet and was very professional! Time frame that was given was accurate and price was very fair!

The staff here are friendly and knowledgeable. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and will help you out in anyway they can. Angie the owner, took the time to answer my questions and made sure my dog felt comfortable the entire time. The salon itself is clean, peaceful, and well-equipped with everything that I needed. Would come again!

We absolutely love Groomer 19! It’s a very friendly, family-owned small business that truly cares about their customers and pets. The place is always clean, and the service is excellent.

We especially love their self-wash station - it’s so convenient, and they have strong high-velocity dryers that work great. They also offer an unlimited self-wash package at a very affordable price, which is an amazing deal.

We showed up close to closing time, and they kindly stayed open for us anyway. On top of that, they even gave our dog a wrapped Christmas gift, which was such a thoughtful touch.

Highly recommend Groomer 19 to anyone looking for great service and a welcoming atmosphere! 🐾

Groomer 19 in Point Loma is the best. The self wash stations are super convenient and the high velocity dryers are far better than the OB self wash. They get my golden retriever dry in minutes. The unlimited monthly self wash package is a great price and perfect for regular beach play days or muddy mishaps at the dog park.

It is a family run business and the owner Angie and her husband are always friendly, remember our dogs name and check in with us.

Today the owner noticed my dog was thirsty and he brought her a clean bowl and a bottle of human drinking water. Very cute and very thoughtful.

They also offer pet cologne and perfume after baths and my dog always leaves smelling wonderful. It is a great location in Liberty Station in Point Loma. I recommend this place to all Point Loma pet parents.

Super nice staff. Seems like they knew everybody’s name that walked in. Made it a point of asking me and Camira (my dog) if we needed anything multiple times while I was at the self wash station. Facility was super clean. Highly recommend!

My 6 month old Aussie Berne Doodle  pup got her first full grooming today and the experience was awesome! Angie was very professional explaining to me what she was going to do and how my pup would look when done. She went in looking like a furry Muppet and came out looking like the beautiful pup she was supposed to be! Kudos to the team there and we look forward to our next visit in 7 weeks. I absolutely highly recommend Groomer 19 as it’s truly a rare experience these days to go to a service provider that actually provides great customer service and an excellent result! My pup agrees and gives them four paws up too!

I absolutely love Groomer 19! Angie and her team are amazing! They’ve always treated my Benji as if he was their own and they’ve done an amazing job grooming him. I’ve always been happy with the result and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a groomer! They also do have a self service station where you can bring in your pup to bathe them yourself. Perfect after a beach day!
Tucker LOVES his grooming appointments at Groomer 19. Thank you Angie ❣ Everyone is so nice, he always feels welcome.

Groomer19 always does a beautiful job grooming our labradoodle!! I love the do-it-yourself wash stations which are available for a quick bath after the beach. And the shop is so cute with all of the treats and specialty gifts for the pups! I highly recommend Groomer19.
My dog has been going to Groomer19 for a couple of years now.  She is always happy to go see Angie.  Stella has a very dense coat and Angie does a great job every time.

We have been bringing our 3 year old Springer to Groomer19 for almost two years. The grooming she receives is just excellent. They listened  to our preferences initially and now we just drop her off. We also love that she is happy to go in the back with Angie and she comes out looking great.

I’ve been going to Groomer 19 for 2 years and absolutely love it! My pup used to be so scared of the groomer but since finding Angie he’s completely changed. I have a 115lb bernedoodle so finding someone who wouldn’t just shave him down if they see one mat was essential! You can’t go wrong with any of the groomer they’re all so talented!

Great place for grooming and self-wash.  They are patient with my friendly but not very cooperative pup.  We don't do a full grooming, but he looks great after a wash and trim!  Everything is nicely set up for self-wash and they are very helpful.

Groomer 19 in Point Loma is absolutely amazing! Angie, the owner, has employed a staff that are not only exceptional groomers, but caring and compassionate animal lovers. Our sheepadoodle, Mackenzie, was terrified of being groomed until we found Groomer 19. We are so fortunate to have groomers who love their work, our dog and do a wonderful job in helping her look and feel not only comfortable, but beautiful! We have recommended them to all of our pet owner friends, who are equally thankful and delighted to have such terrific and skilled professionals caring for their pets

Angie and her team at Groomer19 are the absolute BEST. I have a sweet little nervous rescue. From day 1 Angie was super patient and I immediately felt comfortable leaving my little girl with her. My sweet pup always comes out looking beautiful and best of all smelling wonderful! Nothing but good things to say.
Love taking our pups to Angie! They always look great

We take our Bernedoodle in weekly for a bath and brush.  The grooming and haircuts have been the most professional I have come across since owning my doodle. Cooper is always happy and smells so good when we pick him up.
Angie is the absolute best! She has been so patient with her♥️
Angie and staff are great! Take my dog 2x/month and they take wonderful care of her, and do an amazing job. Especially when our pup gets matted.
We love Groomer 19! Finn the Facility/therapy dog goes here for all his grooming.  They are amazing!

I’ve been going to Groomer 19 and friends  for 5 months.  My pup has always come home happy and clean and well groomed. I am not in for shave and wash. My pup is true to her bread and has a moppys look about her that makes her personality. The people at groomers 19 are so in tuned with your breeds look that they make your pup feel so special. And that makes me feel so good. I love my pup and Angie does too   🫶🏻
The best groomer in San Diego. Angie has always gone above and beyond to make each of our experiences amazing. She takes great care of my little ones. Would highly recommend!

We love Groomer19 salon! My husky of course has so much hair but she comes out of her appointments looking and feeling great!!
I have tried many groomers for her in the past but Groomer19 is my only salon now!
She comes out dry!! Other salons usually leave her still a little damp which isn’t fun to have in the car Hahaa and she is so soft and fluffy it’s adorable!
Highly recommend!

Very Disappointed. I do not recommend if you have a doodles. They shaved almost a bald spot inbetween her ears. A few more inches and it would look like a curtain cut lol. Accidentally or intentionally, I’m surprised they allow dogs to leave in this condition. It looks silly and embarrassing to us and to the establishment.
2 stars because the gentleman was very friendly and  professional and squeezed us in. Real nice guy! I assumed he was the owner. I wish I would have spoke with him for at least a small discount because this looks ridiculous.
If I had to come again it would be for the self service baths only.  Clean place, nice owner. But Poodles beware.

Fantastic service, clean facilities and professional and friendly staff makes it a joy to get our bulldog serviced at Groomer19. The equipment is always ready to take walk-ins for self-washing and the attention to detail is off the chain! If you live in Point Loma or the surrounding area, drop in! You won't be disappointed and you'll be returning frequently.

I’ve been using Groomer 19 for two years now. I have two English Labs I bring in for baths once a month. Angie and the rest of the staff are friendly, upbeat, and professional. Their space is clean and has lots of parking out front. Added plus is they are Liberty Station close to all the shops, so I can run errands while my dogs are getting bathed.

Angie and the whole staff are amazing! Angie is dedicated to having people at the salon with excellent training, and I have always been happy with my dog’s grooming. He adores her and is always excited to go to the salon for a bath or full groom. Angie takes the time to ask about special requests at each groom, provides helpful recommendations regarding care, and she exudes warmth toward every dog with whom I have seen her interact. She is also skilled at working with anxious dogs and will provide honest and trustworthy consultation regarding pets with special needs. A friend’s rescue dog, who has a trauma background, has been a happy repeat customer of hers.

The shop itself is beautiful, with high quality grooming products, toys, and treats for purchase, and it is a great location with convenient parking in back. The self wash stations are also easy to use, with ramps (my dog has refused to use stair entry tubs before) and high quality products provided.

I highly recommend Groomers19, and experience Angie to be a kind, honest, and skilled groomer and business owner!

Groomer 19 has provided exceptionally pleasant and professional service, and deserves the patronage of all pet owners in Point Loma. They have worked really hard to establish themselves in the community and take superb care of our animals. My dog, a small little miniature pincher mix, is usually frightened around strangers, but these people set her at ease and make the whole experience pleasant and safe.
Cookie had her first self-wash here after a sandy beach day, and it went so smoothly! The setup was super easy to use, and the staff always makes us feel welcome. Thanks Groomer19!

10/10 service!! Absolutely fabulous staff and service! They were so patient with my dog and took things slow with her, even gave her treats to make her feel more comfortable. Could not recommend more!!
BEST PRODUCTS
My 18 lb pup was groomed by Monae and she did a wonderful job. It’s nice to have a reliable spot in Liberty Station.

The before and after pics say it all!!!

These guys really understand how to make a nervous, long-overdue-for-a-grooming pup feel comfy, and they did a beautiful job!

Highly recommend.

Angie is the most amazing patient groomer ever!  I started bringing my little guy almost two years ago and I cannot say enough about her service.   I think she really is a dog whisperer.  My king loves the Theraclean and we can never go back to regular baths- he won’t allow it. Don’t hesitate to bring your pet in for pampering and love :)

On very short notice, Angie squeezed the 2 Siberian cats I was boarding into back-to-back grooming appointments during a busy holiday week. They looked and smelled fantastic when they came home and it significantly reduced their voluminous shedding. She was very responsive - great customer service! Highly recommend.

the best self wash and groomer in town. They owners truly care for your pets well being and are so accommodating to senior dogs too. Their self wash or groomer is genuinely so good. My dog loved going there and getting her baths . All their …

I have nothing but the nicest things to say about Groomer19! I took my 7 month old Bernedoodle puppy for his first haircut and Eliza was AMAZING with him!! I was a little nervous because he’s so high energy but Eliza must have some magic …

Angie is so gentle and patient with our cats who hate a car ride much less a bath.  Our cats always come back home smelling great, are super relaxed and sleep like babies after a visit to Groomer19.  We are so happy to have you in the neighborhood!!

If you are looking for a Pitbull friendly pet groomer, look no further!!
Groomer 19 & Friends Pet Salon is fantastic and, most importantly, our dog was happy!! The care and attention to detail are evident from the moment you walk in. …
